privacy_scope.scanned: Complete three-file public transport, recursive gzip/tar contents and metadata; raw Git tree entry names separately. Selected path-value and path-prefix SHA-256 corpora derived in memory from private q2332 originals and the original 059 queue, along with a separate known GPU digest corpus.
privacy_scope.qualification: No raw path values or individual path-value digests are included in these receipts. Pattern-, corpus-, encoding- and depth-limited; unknown sensitive values and unrelated prior Git history are not cleared.

verification_scope: The public verifier checked archived evidence identities, 22 per-revision path proofs, 10 exact historical records, 40 personally displayed and registered source windows, six separately preserved malformed first attempts, and optional Git commit-to-tree and selected source-record identities. It did not run product code or validate runtime behavior.
